content: You will be given an argumentation and asked about to find the relation from relation types: sup (support), exa (support by example), add (additional source), reb (rebutting attack), und (undercutting attack), joint (joining relation) between two selected argument components from it.

From time immemorial humans have had complementary medicine, and it has not generally been ineffective. A reduction in the amount of chemically produced medication per person is most certainly desirable. This will do little damage to the pharmaceutical industry, and conventional medicine will also hardly suffer. The patient could learn to be more aware of his or her body and to treat it more healthily.
What is the relation between "From time immemorial humans have had complementary medicine," and "A reduction in the amount of chemically produced medication per person is most certainly desirable." from the above essay? Choose from following options  1. reb
2. und
3. joint
4. exa
5. sup
6. no relation
